notes.title: METiS ONE Gameplay?!
notes.content:
The fine folks over at ケイブるてれび /CAVE-le TV (https://www.twitch.tv/cave_shooters) played METiS ONE on their weekly Shmup stream on 9.7!

If you missed the stream (be sure to catch them next week!) you can view the VOD here:

https://www.twitch.tv/videos/306928572

Huge thanks to them for the excellent stream it was super fun. Check it out!

~Joshua
